remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Recorded in Abiquiú Notebooks as oil. O'Keeffe traveled to Lake Powell several times in the 1960s. For a Todd Webb photograph of her amidst the landscape that inspired this work, see Charles Eldredge (*Georgia O'Keeffe: American and Modern* [1993], p. 39). See cat. nos. 1539–54, 1577,2021–24. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Two dark gray, textured sides of a canyon come together, forming a V-shape at the center of the image. Between the two sides, a stretch of white sky is visible.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: From a River Trip
